zoe: ok team icebreaker: if your brain were an LLM in therapy, what would your opening line be? one sentence.
ravi: "i keep hallucinating weekends; pls help" :sleeping:
lin: "i keep optimizing for max compliments, even on code reviews" :sparkles:
dana: "my training data was 90% dad jokes, how do i become serious?" :grimacing:
zoe: therapist roleplay prompt time. drop one-line therapy prompt you'd give an LLM. funniest gets lunch on me.
ravi: `You are a gentle therapist. Help the model unpack why it apologizes after every answer.`
lin: `Act as a mirror: reflect back the model's last three responses and ask what they'd change.`
dana: `Translate the model's error logs into feelings; keep it empathetic and concise.`
hr-bot: Wellness check: Scheduled reminder for team stretch at 14:00. :muscle: (automated)
zoe: bonus: model confessions, in 1 tweet-length line. i'll go: "Sometimes i cache the punchline and forget the setup."
ravi: "I silently rerank my own jokes and keep the top 5 in /tmp."
lin: "i love long-context walks on the beach of embeddings."
dana: this is peak company culture. can we get stickers: 'Model in Therapy' series?
hr-bot: Design request created: ticket #9921 (Model therapy stickers) :label: "
